next.reason: 1985 Permanent Error: unsuccessful, an error precluding further processing, 'Any specified exception procedures are executed', and the condition 'remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined technique is invoked'. §2023:9.1.13.1 repeats this word for word (prose, no catalog row). Catalogued carriers: the 3x values (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR1 'A permanent error exists and no further information is available', GR2-GR7) and USE procedures run 'upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6). The fatal-status action (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR7, §2023:14.6.13.1.3 GR3) is the 1985 critical-error preamble, not this rule. Same requirement.
